description: This file defines classes and methods for reading binary data streams, including abstractions over various input sources such as streams, buffers, and sequences. It includes the core Reader class and utility methods for parsing primitive data types, variable-length integers, and managing input positions within the Orleans.Serialization.Buffers namespace.

classes.name: ReaderInput
classes.description: Abstract base class for input sources providing binary data reading capabilities such as position management and byte reading.

classes.name: StreamReaderInput
classes.description: Implementation of ReaderInput that reads data from a Stream asynchronously.

classes.name: Reader
classes.description: Ref struct providing methods to read primitive types, variable-length integers, and manage input positions from various input sources, supporting sequence, span, buffer slice, and stream inputs.

methods.name: Reader.Create
methods.description: Factory methods for creating a Reader instance for different input types such as buffers, streams, and sequences.

methods.name: Reader.ReadByte
methods.description: Reads a single byte from the input source.

methods.name: Reader.ReadInt32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit integer from the input source.

methods.name: Reader.ReadUInt32
methods.description: Reads an unsigned 32-bit integer from the input source.

methods.name: Reader.ReadInt64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit integer from the input source.

methods.name: Reader.ReadUInt64
methods.description: Reads an unsigned 64-bit integer from the input source.

methods.name: Reader.ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes into an array or span.

methods.name: Reader.TryReadBytes
methods.description: Attempts to read a specified number of bytes without advancing the position if insufficient data.

methods.name: Reader.ReadVarUInt32
methods.description: Reads a variable-width encoded unsigned 32-bit integer.

methods.name: Reader.ReadVarUInt64
methods.description: Reads a variable-width encoded unsigned 64-bit integer.

methods.name: Reader.ForkFrom
methods.description: Creates a forked reader starting at a specified position for parallel or nested parsing.

methods.name: Reader.ResumeFrom
methods.description: Resumes reading from a specified position after a forked reader is done.
